notes: DeepSeek Harness instantiates the one-model plan-to-implement mode pair. Bare /plan activates plan mode and the following normal task message produces a durable open exit_plan_mode call and working -> waiting. Approving the review appends the successful result, deactivates plan mode at the next accepted step, and continues the same turn into a real bash edit before completed turn/end produces ready. Transcript assertions make the state arc non-vacuous and require the plan gate, editor tool, two model-attributed contributions, and one completed boundary.
